ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level distribution is heavily weighted toward low-intensity pixels (dark gray/black) with high-intensity highlights (white/off-white) localized to <10% of the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad contiguous low-intensity regions across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white focal points located on the medial left lobe and a prominent high-intensity patch on the upper-medial right lobe. Dense high-contrast clusters concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Frequent, irregular serration pattern extracted along the trailing edges. Discrete peaks and valleys (5-15 pixel amplitude) are most prominent on the distal thirds of both lobes, creating a jagged linear boundary against the sky/water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lower lobe margins follow a convex sweep from the water line toward acute distal tips. Trailing edges exhibit a generally linear trajectory with significant localized jaggedness.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the distal tips of both lobes. Sparse white circular spots visible on the interior ventral surface of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single distinct, unaligned high-contrast linear pixel disruption (scratch) is visible on the lower medial section of the right lobe, oriented diagonally toward the central region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle colonization on distal tips; deep irregular indentation/missing tissue on the trailing edge of the right lobe near the apex.
other_distinctive_markers: Vertical cluster of barnacles at the far right distal tip creates a unique, irregular vertical protrusion in the fluke silhouette.
